name: Alex Morgan
summary: Motivated junior software developer with a first-class degree in Computer Science and hands-on experience building web applications and data tools. Strong problem solver who enjoys working in small teams, learning quickly and shipping clean, well-tested code.

Reduced average API response time by 35% by optimising database queries and adding caching.
Wrote unit and integration tests, raising code coverage from 52% to 81%.
Took part in code reviews and sprint planning within an agile team of six.
Developed a Python dashboard that automated weekly reporting, saving the team roughly 5 hours a week.
Cleaned and analysed datasets of 500k+ rows using Pandas and presented findings to stakeholders.
Delivered friendly customer service in a busy store, consistently meeting weekly sales targets.
Trained three new colleagues on tills and stock systems.
Final-year project: a recommendation engine for a campus events app (awarded 84%).
Relevant modules: Algorithms, Databases, Software Engineering, Machine Learning.
